qs.s: L'eau est ___ pour la survie de tous les êtres vivants.

qs.s: Il est ___ de protéger l'environnement pour les générations futures.

qs.en: This match is critical for the team's qualification.

qs.en: The doctors made crucial decisions to save the patient.

qs.en: The first days after an operation are crucial for recovery.

qs.en: This step is crucial to complete the project on time.

qs.en: The collected data will be crucial for the scientific analysis.

qs.en: My uncle spent twenty years in the national navy before retiring.

qs.en: The government decided to strengthen the navy's personnel to protect the coastline.

qs.en: He is studying merchant seamanship to become an officer on a cargo ship.

qs.en: The police found a corpse in the abandoned warehouse.

qs.en: The forensic doctor examined the corpse to determine the cause of death.

qs.s: Les soldats ont laissé des ___ sur le champ de bataille.
qs.en: The soldiers left dead bodies on the battlefield.

qs.s: On a retrouvé un ___ dans la rivière ce matin.
qs.en: A dead body was found in the river this morning.

qs.s: Les enquêteurs ont identifié ___ cadavre grâce à ses empreintes digitales.
qs.en: The investigators identified the corpse through its fingerprints.

qs.s: Il a trébuché et est tombé sur ___ cadavre dans l'obscurité.
qs.en: He tripped and fell on a corpse in the darkness.
